# Authorization matrix

<!-- Generated by tools/SchoMans.DocGen from the code. Do not edit by hand; change the code and run `dotnet run --project tools/SchoMans.DocGen`. -->

Which role may call which endpoint, from the policies registered on the endpoints. This is the first layer (the role policy); a second layer in the Application layer then checks ownership, for example that a parent sees only their own children. `any` means anonymous, `signed in` means any signed-in user.

## Policies

| Policy | Roles |
| --- | --- |
| Admin | Admin |
| AnyRole | Principal, Teacher, Student, Parent, Admin, Applicant |
| Applicant | Applicant |
| Approvers | Principal, Admin, Teacher |
| Editors | Admin, Principal |
| Parent | Parent |
| Principal | Principal |
| RequestUsers | Principal, Admin, Teacher, Parent, Student |
| StaffRead | Admin, Principal, Teacher |
| Student | Student |
| Teacher | Teacher |
| TeachingStaff | Teacher, Principal |
